full_job_description: About the job About Juniper Square Our mission is to unlock the full potential of private markets. Privately owned assets like commercial real estate, private equity, and venture capital make up half of our financial ecosystem yet remain inaccessible to most people. We are digitizing these markets, and as a result, bringing efficiency, transparency, and access to one of the most productive corners of our financial ecosystem. If you care about making the world a better place by making markets work better through technology – all while contributing as a member of a values-driven organization – we want to hear from you. Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. About Your Role We are looking for a highly skilled Backend Engineer to design, build, and scale secure, high-performance public-facing APIs. You will play a key role in developing robust backend services using Python, FastAPI, Celery, PostgreSQL, and AWS, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance in production environments. This role requires strong engineering fundamentals, API design expertise, and experience building distributed systems. Exposure to frontend technologies is considered a strong advantage. What you’ll do Design, develop, and maintain public-facing RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI Architect scalable backend systems with clean, modular, and testable code Implement asynchronous/background processing using Celery Design and optimise schemas and queries in PostgreSQL Deploy, monitor, and scale applications on AWS Ensure API security, authentication, authorisation, and rate limiting Implement observability (logging, metrics, tracing) for production systems Write unit, integration tests and technical documentation Participate in code reviews Participate in architecture discussions and collaborate cross-functionally Ensure high availability and reliability of APIs Qualifications 4-6 years of experience in full-stack software development. Strong proficiency in Python/Java Hands-on experience with FastAPI (or similar frameworks like Flask/Django REST) Proven experience building and scaling public-facing APIs Strong understanding of REST principles, API versioning, and backward compatibility Experience with asynchronous task processing using Celery Solid experience with PostgreSQL (query optimisation, indexing, transactions) Strong understanding of database design and performance tuning Experience with caching mechanisms such as Redis Experience deploying and operating services on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, ECS/EKS preferred) Experience with API Gateway, rate limiting, and web application firewalls (WAF) Strong understanding of authentication and authorisation (OAuth2, JWT) Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform / CloudFormation) Experience with frontend technologies (React / Next.js / TypeScript) is an added advantage At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this job sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the qualifications

full_job_description: About the job About First American India At First American (India), we build technology that powers millions of real estate transactions. Our people-first culture encourages innovation, collaboration, and solving real-world problems on a scale. If you're driven by impact, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to shape how world-class products are delivered at scale—this is the place for you. Role Summary We are looking for a Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for our T3 NPS (National Production Services) platform. This role requires deep expertise in designing and building scalable, secure, cloud-native systems, along with strong full-stack capabilities and architectural ownership. You will drive key technical decisions, mentor engineers, and modernize our platform using modern and AI-assisted engineering practices. What You’ll Do Lead design of scalable, secure, event-driven microservices and define standards for reliability, performance, and observability. Drive cloud-native modernization on AWS using Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, RDS, and DynamoDB. Champion Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD automation, and distributed system patterns (Kafka, SNS/SQS). Deliver end-to-end features using Python/.NET Core backends and ReactJS/Angular frontends. Establish strong testing, security, performance, and operational excellence practices. Promote AI-assisted development and identify opportunities to integrate AI/ML capabilities. Mentor engineers and partner with Product and Business teams on scalable solutions. Skills & Experience 10+ years of software engineering experience with senior technical leadership. Strong background in cloud-native, distributed systems and microservices. Hands-on experience with Python, ReactJS/Angular, TypeScript, and AWS. Expertise in containers, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and observability. Solid understanding of security, reliability, and performance engineering. Exposure to AI-assisted development and interest in applying AI at scale. What Makes You a Great Fit You think about platforms and systems, influence without authority, navigate ambiguity well, and balance technical depth with business impact—while being passionate about transforming real estate technology.

full_job_description: About the job AKS DevOps Engineer Experience: 7 Years Location: Bangalore Work Mode: Hybrid Roles and Responsibilities: Provisioning and Configuration You provision and configure AKS clusters, including networking, node pools, and integration with Azure services. You deploy and manage Service Mesh solutions while enabling control plane metrics for observability and traffic management. You implement and maintain security policies and access control (RBAC) using Azure RBAC and Kubernetes RBAC, with regular security testing. You support application deployment and testing, including load testing, namespace configuration, and CI/CD integration. You automate infrastructure and ensure compliance through Infrastructure as Code and operational standards. Operations and Support You manage and optimize AKS cluster resources, identities, and certificates to ensure secure and efficient operations. You monitor service levels, regional quotas, and cluster-specific limits to guarantee availability and anticipate scaling needs. You perform regular updates on AKS clusters and apply security patches. You implement backup and disaster recovery strategies to protect workloads and ensure business continuity. You provide operational support, including network management, creating tickets with Microsoft support, and assisting end users. You document and share lessons learned for continuous improvement. On-call Service You monitor and optimize costs related to shared AKS clusters. Security and compliance You maintain and strengthen the security posture of AKS clusters by identifying vulnerabilities, hardening configurations, and applying best practices. You ensure compliance with policies through their application and remediation using Azure Policy and native Kubernetes tools. You leverage recommendations from Azure Advisor and Microsoft Defender for Cloud to improve security, reliability, and operational excellence. Preferred skills: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or equivalent experience. Solid experience in operational analysis within complex IT environments. Practical experience with IT infrastructure components (e.g., OpenShift & OpenStack containers), network, and platforms. Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Cloud fundamentals (Full learning path). Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, Service Mesh technologies (e.g., Istio), API gateways. Knowledge of operating systems. General knowledge of hybrid infrastructure and architecture (servers, VMs, disks, storage, LAN, clustering, etc.). You are continuously learning and ready to undertake the necessary Microsoft Azure training to succeed in your mission. You have an analytical and assertive mindset. You are optimistic, solution-oriented, creative, and open-minded. You naturally have a sense of customer service. You are a good team player. A good command of English is mandatory (spoken and written).
